text:
Situation: Diazepam 10 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 31 tablets (4.7 days on hand). Corvale General holds 142 tablets (18.3 days on hand). Both sites use product labeled by ASCLEMED USA INC. (NDC 76420031610) manufactured at ASCLEMED USA INC. DBA ENOVACHEM (FEI 3001452204).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1067059 at that plant ended 2018-09-27 and was classified OAI with a known date of 2018-12-26. A Warning Letter was issued to the plant on 2019-06-11. The most recent inspection was NAI on 2025-03-05.

Our position: No national shortage exists. The supply imbalance is local. Corvale General has sufficient stock to support Corvale East without dropping below two weeks on hand. Alternative manufacturers are not on the FDA shortage list and their labels do not identify a verifiable plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 33 tablets of 10 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East. Approval required: Pharmacy Director and completion of a controlled-substance transfer record (Schedule III-V).
2. If transfer is not feasible, purchase from Aurobindo Pharma Limited. Approval required: Buyer.
3. If transfer is not feasible, purchase from Chartwell RX, LLC. Approval required: Buyer.
4. If transfer is not feasible, purchase from Clinical Solutions Wholesale, LLC. Approval required: Buyer.
5. If transfer is not feasible, purchase from Mylan Institutional Inc. Approval required: Buyer.

Not recommended: No other actions at this time.
